threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You say 'the Tube' without knowing any lines, and you’re still amazed at the number of coffee shops on every corner.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week. A group of kids started a spontaneous dance party in the back, whole bus joined in. Pure South London magic.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a bus in the middle of a strike, yet the driver still took the time to help a lost tourist. That’s when I knew I'd found my home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find techno raves in old factories, where the soundtrack blends with the sound of trains passing by at dawn.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local if they know to avoid Civic Center during BART meltdowns and still get stuck in Muni delays caused by a dog on the tracks.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: You haven’t truly experienced Muni until you've shared a bus ride with a magician performing card tricks—while the bus is stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about the parks and cafes, but few notice the antique shops tucked away—real hidden gems often ignored.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they order a 'café con leche'—it's always with a rushed 'por favor' like they expect it to be served on a silver platter.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think waiting for a bus is an option; real locals are masters of the night bike ride or the Uber shuffle.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken from a late-night stall on the 35 last week. Best part of the ride was watching folks fight the urge to get off for a bite.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting at the café, I watched a toddler barter their toy for a piece of cake. That’s when it hit me - this place really runs on smiles and sweet deals.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you see a group of punks arguing with a group of hipsters over the best currywurst late at night, while a stray cat watches. It's oddly charming.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they calmly step over the Muni delays caused by a dog on the tracks like it’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full suit pull out a ukulele and start playing while waiting for the Muni. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think ‘Gràcia’ means just Gaudí. They miss the quiet corners where neighbors gather, like at Plaça de la Virreina, away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always spot a recent arrival by the way they still marvel at the tiny balconies, trying to fit an entire garden on them.
